# CARI Journals

> > A comprehensive academic publishing platform offering peer-reviewed journals across eight major disciplines including medical sciences, biological sciences, engineering, business, economics, education, development policy, and social sciences.

CARI Journals is a multidisciplinary academic publisher hosting specialized journal collections that serve researchers, practitioners, and students across diverse fields. The platform provides access to high-quality research publications covering everything from healthcare and agriculture to finance and strategic management.

## Key Topics

- Academic Journals
- Peer-Reviewed Publications
- Medical and Health Sciences
- Biological Sciences
- Business and Economics
- Engineering and Technology
- Development Policy
- Education and Linguistics
- Social Sciences
- Finance and Accounting
- Agricultural Research
- Supply Chain Management
- Entrepreneurship
- Strategic Management
- Food Sciences

## Medical and Health Sciences

- [Medical and Health Sciences Archives - CARI Journals](https://carijournals.org/product-category/medical-and-health-sciences): Medical and Health Sciences journals for healthcare, nursing, and public health research.

## Science and Research Collections

- [Biological Sciences Archives - CARI Journals](https://carijournals.org/product-category/biological-sciences): Biological Sciences journal collection covering health, agriculture, and food safety research.
- [Physical Sciences Archives - CARI Journals](https://carijournals.org/product-category/physical-sciences): Physical Sciences journals covering statistics, geography, climate, and environment.
- [Engineering Archives - CARI Journals](https://carijournals.org/product-category/engineering): Engineering journals for computing, technology, and systems research publications.

## Business, Economics, and Policy

- [Business and Economics Archives - CARI Journals](https://carijournals.org/product-category/business-and-economics): Business and Economics journals for finance, entrepreneurship, and strategic management.
- [Development Policy Archives - CARI Journals](https://carijournals.org/product-category/development-policy): Development Policy journals focusing on poverty, investment, and public administration.

## Education and Social Sciences

- [Education Archives - CARI Journals](https://carijournals.org/product-category/education): Education journals covering linguistics, distance learning, and historical studies.
- [Social Sciences Archives - CARI Journals](https://carijournals.org/product-category/social-sciences): Social Sciences journals for culture, conflict management, and humanities research.
